Hi team,

As a heads-up: biannual manager check-ins run next week. Please complete manager-facing notes for everyone on your direct report list by EOD Friday (2026-02-19). Two process items to follow closely:

1) Manager template: use the attached "manager_checkin_template.docx" to capture goals, OKR alignment, calibration notes, and recommended calibration band.

2) Sensitive/confidential items (PIP concerns, documented performance issues, medical accommodations, compensation exceptions): DO NOT put those items in the shared Drive doc or copy into the general OKR doc. Instead, use the secure People Ops upload link (listed below) or send via the secure vendor form if you need encrypted transit. Laura is cc'd and will confirm receipt and logging.

I've attached the comp calibration matrix and a short redaction guideline (how to reference sensitive issues without PII) — follow it strictly. If you have questions about what belongs in the secure channel vs the manager summary, flag them on this thread.

Next steps:
- Fill the template for each direct report by Fri EOD (2026-02-19).
- Upload any sensitive notes to the secure People Ops form (https://people.redwood-inference.com/secure-note-upload).
- We'll run calibration on Monday 2026-02-22 10:00am PST; calendar invite to follow.

Thanks,
Karthik

Hi Karthik and Monica,

Thanks for the clear heads-up. A couple of practical rules from People Ops that we'll enforce this cycle so audits are clean and records are searchable: 

1) Borderline operational performance notes: you may include a high-level, non-identifying flag in the shared manager template (e.g., "conduct/attendance concern — under coaching"). Do NOT include PII, medical details, or anything that looks like an investigatory record.

2) Compensation exceptions: yes, include the proposed band/rationale in the manager template. Upload supporting docs (previous offer letters, market comps, manager justification) to the secure upload link so it can be attached to the official HR case.

3) PIP or formal disciplinary notes: upload only via the encrypted People Ops form. Use the vendor secure form if you prefer third-party encryption (talentops+secure@vendor-forms.com). We will confirm receipt and create a Jira (JIRA-HR-4287) to track.

4) Retention & logging: anything submitted to the secure form will be logged under the employee HR record and retained per our policy (7 years for investigatory docs). Redaction guideline attached. 

I'll be monitoring uploads and will ping you if anything needs clarification.

Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
